definitions.explanation: A bullet or projectile fired from a gun. When read {弾|たま}, the character refers to ammunition; the same character is read {弾|だん} in compounds such as {弾丸|だんがん} (bullet).

examples.japanese: {弾|たま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
{弾|たま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{構|かま}えた→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧。
examples.english: I loaded a round and took aim.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撃|う}った→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧{弾|たま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧、⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The bullet I fired missed the target and hit the wall.

notes:
When read {弾|たま}, this character means a bullet or round of ammunition. The same sound is written ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (ball, sphere) or {球|たま} (ball) for other senses — the {弾|たま} spelling specifically signals ammunition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾|たま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to load a bullet
- {弾|たま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to run out of ammunition
- {弾|たま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撃|う}つ→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧: to fire a shot

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧: bullet — the standard compound noun (⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧ reading)
- {実弾|じつだん}: live ammunition
